step.label: Två händer, ett kort till platsen

prompt.text: Locked camera, one continuous shot. Her hand at the shoe strokes the yellow card out of the window and slides it flat on the felt a short way out from the shoe. Her other hand takes the card there, holding it by its edges between thumb and fingers, and carries it low over the felt to its place in the middle of the picture, where the last frame shows it. On the way her wrist turns over and the card turns with it in her fingers, from its yellow back to its blue face: the card never turns by itself and never leaves her fingers before it lies. She lays it flat at its place and lets go. Then that hand glides back low over the felt and comes to rest flat in front of her, and her hand from the shoe settles back on the shoe, as in the last frame. Her eyes follow the card. She moves naturally, like a practised dealer, with soft, relaxed arms and hands. Only one card moves: a small card, about half as long as her hand, which keeps the size it has in the last frame all the way from the shoe to its place. Its back is plain solid yellow and its face is solid blue with a small pink cross in the middle and a small red dot in one corner, as the last frame shows it. A yellow card shows in the window of the shoe all the time: as she strokes one out, the next one is already there.
